name: Exceptions
_about: Spec v1.4 (05 Shared Engines / 05 Exceptions, EX-2): where the problem was found and where it was caused, and who is at fault, so damage can be traced to its origin.

fields.name: Found_Stage
fields.label: Found at
fields.helpText: Set by the server from where the exception was raised.

fields.name: Caused_Stage
fields.label: Caused at
fields.helpText: Damage found at QC but caused in transit is a freight problem, not a QC problem.

fields.name: Resolved_At
fields.label: Resolved At
fields.helpText: Stamped by the server when the status becomes Resolved.
